name: pg_triggers_maketransitioncapturestate_return_consistent
area: triggers, transition tables on partitioned tables
goal:
A partitioned table carries an UPDATE trigger declared REFERENCING NEW TABLE and, at the same time, a DELETE trigger declared REFERENCING OLD TABLE. For an UPDATE command the state built to capture transition tuples comes out internally inconsistent: the flags that say which transition tables are wanted do not agree with the tuplestores actually handed over.

A cross-partition update on such a table then behaves wrongly, and on some builds crashes.

For every combination of trigger events and transition tables the flags and the tuplestores have to describe the same thing. A table carrying only one of the two triggers must keep behaving as it does now.
